question: Which man of God am I?
reference: Exodus 2-4; 32; Numbers 20 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Moses', p. 434)

clues: As a baby I was hidden in a basket among the reeds of a river.
I killed an Egyptian and fled to the land of Midian for forty years.
I led a nation out of slavery through a sea that parted before them.
I was kept out of the Promised Land for striking a rock instead of speaking to it.

question: Which shepherd-prophet am I?
reference: Amos 1; 7 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 1, 'Amos')

clues: I was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore figs from Tekoa in Judah.
God sent me north to prophesy against Israel's wealthy and complacent.
The priest at Bethel told me to go back home and prophesy there.
I saw visions of a basket of summer fruit and a plumb line.

question: Which woman of a doomed city am I?
reference: Joshua 2; 6 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Rahab No. 1')

clues: I lived in a house built into the city wall of a doomed city.
I hid two Israelite spies under stalks of flax on my roof.
I asked them to spare my family when their army came.
I tied a scarlet cord in my window as the agreed sign.

question: Which prophet of the Bible am I?
reference: 1 Samuel 3; 8; 15-16 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Samuel', p. 851)

clues: As a boy I served at the sanctuary and heard a voice call my name in the night.
The people demanded a king, and God had me warn them what a king would take.
I anointed the first king of Israel, then rejected him for disobedience.
I secretly anointed a shepherd boy from Bethlehem as the next king.

question: Which Son of Thunder am I?
reference: Mark 3:17; John 19:26; Revelation 1:9 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'John No. 3', p. 90)

clues: Jesus nicknamed my brother and me the Sons of Thunder.
I am often called the disciple whom Jesus loved.
From the cross, Jesus placed the care of his mother in my hands.
I was exiled to the island of Patmos, where I received the Revelation.

question: Which preacher in Samaria am I?
reference: Acts 8 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Philip No. 2')

clues: I was one of the seven appointed alongside Stephen.
I preached in a city of Samaria and many were baptized.
An angel sent me to a desert road toward Gaza.
There I explained Isaiah's scroll to an Ethiopian official and baptized him.

question: Which woman at the empty tomb am I?
reference: Luke 8:2; John 20 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Mary No. 3')

clues: Jesus had expelled seven demons from me.
I helped support Jesus and the apostles from my own belongings.
I stood near the cross and watched where his body was laid.
I was the first person to see and speak with the resurrected Jesus.

question: Which king of Samaria am I?
reference: 1 Kings 16-22 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 1, 'Ahab No. 1')

clues: I ruled the northern kingdom from the city of Samaria.
My queen was a Sidonian princess who promoted Baal worship.
I sulked in bed because a man named Naboth would not sell me his vineyard.
I died in battle at Ramoth-gilead when an arrow found a gap in my armor.

question: Which foreign ruler am I?
reference: Ezra 1; Isaiah 44-45 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 1, 'Cyrus')

clues: Isaiah named me as God's shepherd about 200 years before I was born.
I founded the Persian Empire and captured Babylon.
In my first year I issued a decree ending the Jewish exile.
I told the Jews to go home and rebuild their temple in Jerusalem.

question: Which favored son am I?
reference: Genesis 37-45 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Joseph No. 1', p. 106)

clues: My father gave me a special long garment, and my brothers hated me for it.
I dreamed that sheaves and stars all bowed down to me.
My brothers sold me to traders headed for Egypt.
Years later I ruled Egypt as second only to Pharaoh and saved my family from famine.

question: Which non-Israelite of the Bible am I?
reference: 2 Kings 5 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Naaman No. 1')

clues: I was the army commander of the king of Syria, and a leper.
A captive Israelite girl in my household told my wife of a prophet who could heal me.
I was insulted that the prophet only sent a messenger with instructions.
After washing seven times in the Jordan, my skin became like a child's.

question: Which city on the Euphrates am I?
reference: 2 Kings 25; Daniel 1-5 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 1, 'Babylon')

clues: I sat on the Euphrates and was famous for my walls and hanging gardens.
My king carried the people of Judah into a seventy-year captivity.
A mysterious hand wrote on my palace wall during a feast.
I fell to the armies of the Medes and Persians in a single night.

question: Which missionary base city am I?
reference: Acts 11; 13 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 1, 'Antioch No. 1')

clues: I was a major city where Greeks first heard the good news in large numbers.
Barnabas came to help, then brought Saul from Tarsus to teach here.
It was here that the disciples were first called Christians.
The congregation here sent out Paul and Barnabas on the first missionary journey.

question: Which wicked queen am I?
reference: 1 Kings 16-21; 2 Kings 9 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Jezebel No. 1')

clues: I was the daughter of a Sidonian king and married into Israel's royal house.
I hunted down the prophets of Jehovah and fed hundreds of prophets of Baal.
I arranged the false trial and killing of Naboth to seize his vineyard.
I was thrown from a window, and dogs ate my body, just as Elijah had foretold.

question: Which official of Judah am I?
reference: Nehemiah 1-6 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Nehemiah', p. 486)

clues: I was the cupbearer to the Persian king when I heard Jerusalem lay in ruins.
The king granted me leave and letters to go and rebuild.
I inspected the broken walls by night before telling anyone my plan.
Despite mockery and threats from Sanballat and Tobiah, the wall was finished in fifty-two days.

question: Which prophet-for-hire am I?
reference: Numbers 22-24 (cross-check: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 1, 'Balaam')

clues: A king hired me to put a curse on Israel as they camped in the plains of Moab.
My donkey saw an angel in the road and spoke to me when I beat her.
Every time I opened my mouth to curse Israel, a blessing came out instead.
I foretold a star that would step forth out of Jacob.
